title: Thai-Style Peanut Chicken Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai-inspired dish made with peanut-infused chicken and toasted pilaf.
instructions: Cook the toasted pilaf according to package instructions.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken breast until cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
In a separate pan, combine peanut butter and light coconut milk, whisking until smooth.
Add the cooked chicken to the peanut-coconut mixture and stir to coat.
Combine the chicken mixture with the cooked toasted pilaf and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped peanuts or toasted sesame seeds, if desired.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
